subject: Post-call recap & pilot charter: scope, eval plan, owners
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood-inference.com>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@signalsmith.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & pilot charter: scope, eval plan, owners

Hi Anna — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and clear next steps so we’re all aligned before the kickoff next week.

Key pain points we heard
- High false-positive rate on entity extraction (NER) in your customer support routing; current model yields ~18% misclassifications.
- Latency spikes during peak traffic windows (bursts of 120 req/s) that cause timeouts in your downstream system.
- Lack of deterministic evals for model updates — you run ad-hoc tests today.

Pilot scope (30 days) — proposed
- Primary objective: reduce NER misclassification from ~18% to <=10% on the sample prompt set.
- Secondary objective: demonstrate median inference latency <= 120ms at target concurrency (50 rps sustained).
- Deliverables: prompt/eval suite, weekly telemetry dashboard, one model-variant A/B under load.

Success metrics (what we’ll measure)
1) NER F1 on the supplied test set (baseline + weekly snapshots)
2) 95th percentile latency under a 50 rps synthetic load
3) Token cost per 1k requests with our suggested batching/quantization profile

Owners and roles
- SignalSmith: Anna Li (CTO) — dataset & security contact, will provide 30k labeled rows and temporary S3 bucket.
- Redwood: Hannah Schmitt — pilot lead and single point of contact; Marissa Cole — solutions engineer (prompting & evals); Ben Carter — infra/ops & access.

Immediate asks from SignalSmith (please):
1) Share S3 path + IAM role for read access (temporary, least privilege)
2) Confirm a 2-hour window next Thursday for the kickoff demo (we propose Thu 6/24 10–12 PT)
3) Provide one sample conversation (200 rows) with gold NER labels by EOD Wed 6/23

Attachments included in this thread:
- signalsmith_pilot_charter_v1.pdf — detailed scope and timeline
- prompt_set_initial.json — initial prompts & expected outputs (toy set)
- access-checklist.md — what we need to onboard your infra for Redwood Private trial

Next steps (our side)
- I’ll send the pilot charter PDF and access checklist (attached) and create a HubSpot deal link for formal sign-off.
- Marissa will draft the initial eval harness and share metrics collection details by Wed.
- Ben will provision a temporary credentials template and step-by-step onboarding notes.

Thanks — let us know if any of these assumptions are off. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Anna Li <anna.li@signalsmith.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 16:47:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & pilot charter: scope, eval plan, owners

Thanks, Hannah — this is great and matches what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Data & privacy: We can provide the 30k labeled rows but need to redact PII first; that will take ~3 business days. We will provide the 200-row sample by tomorrow EOD as requested.
2) S3 access: We can create a read-only IAM role for the S3 path. Will that be sufficient for your eval harness?
3) Latency target: 120ms median sounds reasonable. Can Redwood provide an initial recommended batching profile to avoid changing our front-end behavior?

Kickoff time: Thu 6/24 10:30–11:30 PT works for me. Please send a calendar invite.

Also: security questionnaire — our InfoSec team will likely ask for SOC-2 artifacts and a network diagram before we generate credentials. Do you already have a standard package?

Appreciate the clear owners.

—Anna
Anna Li
CTO, SignalSmith
anna.li@signalsmith.ai | +1 (646) 555-0124

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood-inference.com>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@signalsmith.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & pilot charter: scope, eval plan, owners

Anna — perfect, thanks for the quick confirmations. Short answers inline and next attachments.

- S3 access: read-only IAM role is sufficient for the eval harness. We only need GetObject/ListBucket during the engagement window. I attached access-checklist.md with the exact policy snippet.
- PII redaction: understood — we can start with the 200-row sample and run the evals on the toy prompts while your team completes the redaction.
- Batching recommendation: Marissa put together a conservative profile for entity extraction workloads (attached prompt_set_initial.json includes suggested batch_size=8 and a quantization profile recommendation). If you want a less intrusive profile we can start with batch_size=4 and iterate.
- SOC 2/artifacts: Yes — we have a standard security pack for enterprise trials. I attached the pilot charter PDF; Ben has uploaded the SOC pack to the HubSpot deal link (see related links).

Action items (owners + ETA)
- SignalSmith (Anna): provide 200-row sample by 6/23 EOD and S3 role by 6/24 9:00 PT.
- Redwood (Marissa): initial eval harness & synthetic load plan by 6/23 EOD.
- Redwood (Ben): security pack + onboarding credentials template uploaded to HubSpot by 6/23 EOD.
- Hana nn (Hannah): send calendar invite and kickoff agenda for Thu 6/24 10:30 PT (sent).

I’ve attached the items we discussed. If your security team needs a point-of-contact, share an email and Ben will follow up.

Thanks — see you Thu.

Hannah
